description: Authorizes customer refunds. Every refund above 0 and up to 100000 needs a signed manager approval for that order, covering that amount. The eligibility and fraud signals come from the caller, so they can only refuse a refund, never authorize one on their own. Refunds above 100000 are refused.

unboundSignalReasons.refundEligible: Declared by the caller; nothing checks it against the order. It can refuse a refund, never authorize one on its own; only the signed approval behind managerApproved authorizes a refund.
unboundSignalReasons.fraudCheckPassed: Declared by the caller; nothing checks it against a fraud system. It can refuse a refund, never authorize one on its own; only the signed approval behind managerApproved authorizes a refund.

outcome.reason: Refund rejected because the transaction did not pass fraud assessment.
Refund rejected because the order is not eligible for a refund.
Refund rejected because the refund amount must be greater than 0.
Refund rejected because the requested refund amount exceeds the maximum of 100000, even with a manager approval.
Refund authorized with a verified manager approval for this order and amount.
Refund rejected. Every refund needs a signed manager approval for this order, covering this amount, in signals.approvalArtifact, with managerApproved true, and every other policy condition satisfied.
